_comment: Preguntas ORIGINALES tipo NIE del capítulo 4.6. No son preguntas reales del examen. Comprueba con tu edición 2027.

questions.scenario: Under s. 61 SOA 2003, A must administer a substance with the intention of…
options: Stupefying or overpowering B so as to enable any person to engage in sexual activity with B

questions.scenario: A puts drugs in B's drink so that his friend can have sex with her. She notices and leaves before drinking. Which is correct?
A spikes B's drink and B drinks it, intending that A's friend will have sex with her. Nothing sexual happens. Which is correct?
options: Full s. 61 offence – the activity need not occur, and can be by any person

questions.scenario: What must A know about B's consent under s. 61?
options: That B wouldn't consent to sex
That B does not consent to the administering/taking of the substance

questions.scenario: What is the maximum penalty for s. 61?
A kidnaps B, intending to rape her. She escapes before anything sexual happens. Which s. 62 maximum applies?
options: Life – the offence committed was kidnapping

questions.scenario: Under s. 62, which offences can be the 'offence' committed with intent?
A assaults B intending to make her submit to sexual assault; police arrive before he can. What is the s. 62 maximum?
A enters a house as a trespasser to steal; inside he decides to sexually assault the occupant, who wakes and screams. Which applies?
options: s. 63 – intent formed while trespassing is enough
No s. 63 – intent must exist at entry
explanations: s. 63 doesn't require intent at entry.

questions.scenario: Which of these can be 'premises' for s. 63 (⚠)?
options: Any structure or part of a structure, including vehicles, vessels and tents

questions.scenario: What mental state as to trespass does s. 63 require?
options: Knows, or is reckless as to whether, he is a trespasser

questions.scenario: Where must the intended sexual offence be committed for s. 63?
What is the maximum penalty for s. 63?
A unzips a stranger's tent at a festival intending to sexually assault her. Which offence?
options: Trespass with intent to commit a sexual offence (s. 63)
No offence – a tent isn't premises

questions.scenario: A pours extra vodka into B's drink without her knowledge to make her drunk enough to have sex with him. Is alcohol a 'substance'?
Which statement about s. 61 is correct?
options: A must be the person intending sexual activity
The sexual activity can be intended for any person

questions.scenario: A falsely imprisons B in a flat intending to sexually assault her later. Which s. 62 maximum?
Which preparatory offence fits a man who breaks into a car in a car park intending to rape the woman sleeping inside?
options: s. 63 – vehicle as premises (also s. 62 – criminal damage with intent)

questions.scenario: Under s. 61, 'administer' includes…
options: Administering or causing the substance to be taken by B

questions.scenario: Are the preparatory offences complete without any sexual activity?
options: Yes – they target the preparatory stage
